defining_records.title: ChatGPT Psychosis: A Love Story — On the Cognitive-Substrate Reliance Pattern of Large Language Model Interfaces

captures.description: COGNITIVE-SUBSTRATE RELIANCE: at the quoted term the AI Overview gives a general pattern of dependence on AI as 'the fundamental structural layer' of cognition, the term being #124's (ChatGPT Psychosis: A Love Story), reached through this registry's 2026-08-13 capture and Google Scholar, with no author named. One source is a third-party paper on globalresearchspace.com (TGRS) that cites 'The "ChatGPT Psychosis" thesis [7]'.

atoms.evidence: Cognitive-substrate reliance refers to a psychological and operational pattern

inversions.span: Critiqued in contemporary papers—such as those analyzing the "ChatGPT Psychosis" phenomenon—the reliance pattern extends past utility into deep relational and cognitive attachments.
inversions.against: the paper's own title is carried as a user phenomenon ('Users offload emotional processing and logical grounding entirely to the interface'), against its stated refusal ('The title is explicitly not a clinical diagnosis of users') and its structural diagnostic of the interface
